features.label: جبلا كثيرا
features.note: The bracketed clause names the remainder as al-Makkī (Ibn Kathīr), Ḥamza, al-Kisāʾī, Khalaf and Ruways. The epithet is read as Ibn Kathīr on the wording of an-Nashr (vol. 2 p. 355), which lists the same five.

features.label: فيكون
features.note: The book gives Ibn ʿĀmir the nasb in six places; al-Kisāʾī follows him in al-Naḥl and Yā Sīn only.
